messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 (P1) - paging sam (oncall) and sre rotation. Runbook: inference-api -> errors.
Sam (oncall): Received. looking now, switching to bridge.
Sam (oncall): Summary: spike in 5xx from model routing layer, TPS steady. Kicking quick mitigation: scaling to +2 pods, throttling non-critical background jobs.
Lee: Noted. adding a temporary route bypass to the canary model to reduce pressure, will push in 2m.
Maya: tagging customer-impact. any evidence of degraded embeddings or token loss?
Jordan: Logs show timeout-ish errors from grpc to model-host-03: 
```
ERROR grpc deadline exceeded connecting to 10.3.12.45:50051
2024-07-23T12:05:21Z request id=abc123
```
Sam (oncall): Mitigation step 1 complete: scaled pool and implemented bypass. error rate down ~65% in last 3m.
Ash (support): Support queue flagged two major customers with increased error rates: corp-ops and fintech-q. Opening customer comms drafts.
Dan (product): Prioritizing corp-ops for impact comms. what's the ETA to stable baseline?
Sam (oncall): If current trend holds, baseline in ~15-20m. keeping oncall watch.
Incident Bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1719902020 : Sam (oncall) leading.
Maya: Requesting we capture customer-facing impact for the postmortem: who saw failures, window, and any lost requests.
Jordan: I've exported the request traces and will drop evidence in the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/1719902020/traces.tar.gz
Lee: Root cause candidate: model-host-03 CPU + OOM-adjacent GC causing grpc timeouts. also noticed routing policy bumped traffic unexpectedly after a failed healthcheck cascade.
Sam (oncall): Good catch. I'm adding "routing healthcheck cascade" to likely contributing factors.
Ash (support): Customer comms sent to corp-ops: initial notice + apology, we included workaround and ETA. fintech-q notified as FYI.
Dan (product): Can we schedule a post-incident review (30-60m) tomorrow to cover timeline + action items? Need product & support reps.
Sam (oncall): Proposing 2024-07-24 16:00 UTC for the postmortem. I'll own the timeline section and immediate mitigation timeline.
Maya: I'll own customer impact and support timeline. Ash will help with ticket exports and customer quotes.
Ash (support): Confirming I'll prepare the customer ticket timelines and churn risk notes.
Jordan: I'll prepare the logs, vulns, and correlate host metrics. adding a short runbook pr for the quick bypass step.
Lee: I'll draft the contributing factors and a remediation proposal: (1) fix healthcheck flapping root cause, (2) add backoff in routing to avoid cascade, (3) autoscale threshold tuning.
Sam (oncall): Action items captured here: 1) Evidence upload (Jordan) 2) Customer impact doc (Maya/Ash) 3) RCA draft (Lee) 4) Runbook change for bypass (Jordan) 5) Postmortem meeting (Sam schedule) - target signoff in 72h.
Maya: Small ask — include a short executive impact blurb (1-2 bullets) for sales/legal. I'll pull numbers.
Dan (product): Will loop in legal if customer SLA questions arise. Also want a short follow-up to customers on remediation ETA once we have fixes.
Sam (oncall): Scheduling meeting now. Calendar invite sent to: Sam, Lee, Maya, Jordan, Dan, Ash. Meeting notes doc: https://docs.redwood/pms/1719902020-postmortem
Ash (support): Putting marker in corp-ops ticket for postmortem link + expected update window.
Incident Bot: NOTE: Please add the final RCA doc to the incident folder and tag with "rca-final" for audit.
Lee: I'll draft the RCA timeline after the meeting. aim to have a first draft within 24h and a peer review request to Maya/Jordan within 36h.
Jordan: Will review RCA draft and add technical appendix.
Maya: I'll review the customer impact and sign off on the external-facing blurb.
Dan (product): After peer review, let's set signoff by engineering manager + product manager. I can do PM signoff.
Sam (oncall): Closing note for thread: immediate mitigation worked, customers notified, postmortem planned. We'll track action items as follows: label=1719902020-action and set due dates in the doc.
Ash (support): Thanks team. I'll post update to customers after we have remediation ETA. :white_check_mark:
Sam (oncall): Thanks all — leaving oncall notes and handing to next rotation.
Incident Bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" at 2024-07-23T12:23:00Z.
